I'd ask that you not try to straighten or reposition the pin, and avoid further charging attempts on that side, as that could cause more damage.

To move forward, please send a clear photo of the charging contact area so our team can review it. We'll also need your proof of purchase to check warranty eligibility — could you share that as well? [2] [3]
